description: Cross-species test of whether the TDY motif and the neutral CD window are conserved clade features of plant group D MAPKs rather than an Arabidopsis MPK18 lesion
code:
import requests, re
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

def usearch(q,size=60,fields="accession,id,protein_name,gene_names,organism_name,length,sequence"):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":q,"fields":fields,"format":"json","size":size},timeout=120)
    r.raise_for_status(); return r.json()["results"]

# Reviewed MAPKs across land plants + a moss/alga outgroup, to test whether TDY + degenerate CD
# is a conserved clade feature rather than a lesion specific to Arabidopsis MPK18.
q=("(protein_name:\"mitogen-activated protein kinase\") AND reviewed:true AND "
   "(organism_id:39947 OR organism_id:4577 OR organism_id:3694 OR organism_id:4081 OR "
   "organism_id:3218 OR organism_id:3055 OR organism_id:4113 OR organism_id:3847)")
res=usearch(q,size=120)
print("reviewed plant MAPK entries retrieved:", len(res))

def ape(s):
    h=re.search(r"HRD[LIVM][KR][PAS].N",s)
    if not h: return None
    d=re.search(r"D[FLIW]G",s[h.start():h.start()+80])
    if not d: return None
    d0=h.start()+d.start()
    a=re.search(r"[ASG]P[EQD]",s[d0+12:d0+60])
    return (d0, d0+12+a.start()) if a else None
anc=re.compile(r"A[LM][A-Z]{2}[PAQSV][YFH]")

rows=[]
for e in res:
    s=e["sequence"]["value"]; ap=ape(s)
    if not ap: continue
    d0,a0=ap
    t=re.search(r"T.Y",s[d0:a0])
    if not t: continue
    motif=t.group(0)
    hits=[m for m in anc.finditer(s) if m.start()>a0+85]
    if not hits: continue
    b=s[hits[0].start():hits[0].start()+22]; win=b[9:18]
    net=sum(c in "DE" for c in win)-sum(c in "KR" for c in win)
    gn=(e.get("genes") or [{}])[0].get("geneName",{}).get("value","")
    rows.append(dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],gene=gn,
                     organism=e["organism"]["scientificName"],length=len(s),
                     act_motif=motif,motif_pos=d0+t.start()+1,CD_window=win,CD_net=net,
                     tail_after_APE=len(s)-(a0+3)))
P=pd.DataFrame(rows)
# add Arabidopsis MPK18 explicitly
P=P[~P.acc.duplicated()]
print(f"\nscored {len(P)} plant MAPKs with a complete kinase domain, across "
      f"{P.organism.nunique()} species: {sorted(P.organism.unique())}")
P["clade"]=np.where(P.act_motif=="TDY","TDY","TEY/other")
pd.set_option("display.width",220)
print("\nActivation-loop motif counts:"); print(P.act_motif.value_counts().to_string())
print("\n--- TDY-type plant MAPKs across species ---")
print(P[P.act_motif=="TDY"][["acc","gene","organism","length","act_motif","CD_window","CD_net","tail_after_APE"]]
      .sort_values("organism").to_string(index=False))

a=P[P.clade=="TDY"]; b=P[P.clade=="TEY/other"]
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(b.CD_net,a.CD_net,alternative="greater")
print(f"\nCD-window net acidity: TEY/other n={len(b)} mean={b.CD_net.mean():+.2f}; "
      f"TDY n={len(a)} mean={a.CD_net.mean():+.2f}")
print(f"Mann-Whitney U={u:.1f}, one-sided p={p:.4g}, rank-biserial r={2*u/(len(a)*len(b))-1:+.2f}")
u2,p2=stats.mannwhitneyu(a.tail_after_APE,b.tail_after_APE,alternative="greater")
print(f"C-terminal tail after APE: TDY mean={a.tail_after_APE.mean():.0f} aa vs TEY/other "
      f"mean={b.tail_after_APE.mean():.0f} aa; U={u2:.1f}, one-sided p={p2:.4g}")
P.to_csv("plant_MAPK_crossspecies_TDY_CD_scan.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,4.6))
for cl,c in [("TEY/other","#2a6fb5"),("TDY","#c0504d")]:
    sub=P[P.clade==cl]
    ax[0].scatter(sub.tail_after_APE,sub.CD_net+np.random.RandomState(0).normal(0,.06,len(sub)),
                  s=34,alpha=.8,color=c,label=f"{cl} (n={len(sub)})")
ax[0].scatter([416],[0],s=160,facecolor="none",edgecolor="k",lw=1.6)
ax[0].annotate("AtMPK18",(416,0),xytext=(300,-1.6),fontsize=9,
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=.9))
ax[0].set_xlabel("C-terminal residues after APE"); ax[0].set_ylabel("CD-window net acidic charge")
ax[0].set_title("Plant MAPKs across 8 species: TDY clade has long tails and a neutral CD window")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[1].boxplot([b.CD_net,a.CD_net],labels=[f"TEY/other\nn={len(b)}",f"TDY\nn={len(a)}"],widths=.55)
ax[1].scatter(np.ones(len(b))+np.random.RandomState(1).normal(0,.05,len(b)),b.CD_net,s=22,color="#2a6fb5",alpha=.7)
ax[1].scatter(2*np.ones(len(a))+np.random.RandomState(2).normal(0,.05,len(a)),a.CD_net,s=22,color="#c0504d",alpha=.7)
ax[1].set_ylabel("CD-window net acidic charge")
ax[1].set_title(f"CD-site acidity by clade, Mann-Whitney p={p:.3g}")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
